# ReceiptRecon

## 📌 Project Overview

ReceiptRecon is a Python-based OCR and data extraction tool designed to parse receipt images and extract structured information such as items, prices, totals, and merchant details. It utilizes image preprocessing, text detection, and NLP techniques to accurately understand receipt layouts.

### 🔍 Features
- OCR-based text extraction from receipt images
- Line item parsing and total cost calculation
- Modular and extensible codebase

```bash
python main.py path/to/receipt_image.jpg
```

You can also modify configuration options inside `config.py` if present.
